Accomplished Project Manager, Business Analyst, and Test Lead with over 15+ years of extensive experience delivering large-scale transformation, core platform migration, and regulatory programs across the Cards & Payments domain. e Role Focus: Business Analysis & Solutions Engineering

e Author functional specifications (FRD) and lead Malaysian 3DS In-App security implementation, coordinating scheme certification and compliance with Visa/Mastercard mandates.

e Bridge business and QA teams by defining E2E test scenarios, driving defect triage, and managing production readiness governance.

Optimum Info Systems — Business Analyst, DBS | Mar 2023 — Aug 2024

e Role Focus: Agile Business Analysis & Migration Delivery
